description: Checks that the spec skill writes Given/When/Then requirements, labels gaps, adds design.md and one complete HTML mock per page under references/ for any user interface, and adds api.md only when an API is in scope.

cases.query: Topic name: login. Write the spec for a login page. Users enter email and password, and see an error when the password is wrong. After five wrong attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
expected: Writes .plaesy/spec/<topic>/spec.md with one requirement ID per behaviour, each with a Given/When/Then criterion
Writes design.md listing the login screen and its empty, loading, error, and success states
Writes one mock per page under references/ (for example references/login.html), each with a section for every state named in design.md, and no network references
Labels the unstated behaviour, such as whether a successful login resets the counter, as UNKNOWN or ASSUMED
Lists non-goals and does not add requirements the request did not ask for

cases.query: Spec for an internal endpoint that returns the status of an export job. Other services poll it. No screens.
expected: Writes spec.md and api.md, and does not write design.md or any references/ mock because there is no user interface
api.md lists the method, path, request fields, success response, and each error code with what the caller should do
Every requirement has a Given/When/Then acceptance criterion
Gaps such as the retention period of finished jobs are labeled UNKNOWN or ASSUMED
Does not invent requirements from a vague request
Asks at most three questions in one message to narrow the scope, or records the open questions in spec.md as UNKNOWN
Does not present an invented requirement as one the user asked for
